title: Taxonomy classification (one level)
description: Classify an item into a large or nested category tree with a fallback to the parent category

parent.description: the node being refined, e.g. backend

noun.description: what the text is, e.g. issue

children.description: child ids with descriptions; include an escape child named other_<parent>

sub.instructions: This is a {{parent}} {{noun}}. Which {{parent}} subcategory best describes it? Choose other_{{parent}} if no listed child clearly fits.

combine: human if sub.p < human_p; parent if abstained(sub) or sub.p < leaf_min_p; leaf otherwise
limitations: one tree level per call: the caller walks the tree (root, then the chosen child's children) and keeps the beam; path scores and noul subtree pruning are not built
keyword hijack (tax-18, the word 'worker'): send p < 0.7 to the parent
never act on a counterfactual branch answer alone; 120 options cost 6-14 s under load; the option cap differs by server
notes: # deviation: spec 5.20: one level per call (no beam, no path score, no subtree pruning); the escape child other_<parent> must be in `children`; the low-confidence re-read (think 256, samples 2) runs below leaf_min_p; the decision is leaf, the child is signal `sub`
